guides.title: 曝光焦距與劑量控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Exposure focus and dose control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」建立判讀邊界。焦點需有一致的參考面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define nominal focus and defocus signs to define the interpretation boundary. Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義名目焦點與離焦符號：焦點需有一致的參考面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜畫出表面高度到鏡頭焦點的前饋鏈：量測延遲與空間對應會影響補償。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付包含條件與取樣範圍的控制計畫：控制計畫需要清楚的適用範圍。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define nominal focus and defocus signs: Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch height-to-focus feedforward: Latency and spatial registration affect compensation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver controls with conditions and sampling scope: Control plans need explicit applicability limits. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出表面高度到鏡頭焦點的前饋鏈」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付包含條件與取樣範圍的控制計畫」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch height-to-focus feedforward: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver controls with conditions and sampling scope to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「焦距與劑量是完全相同的控制量。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「高度感測器讀值就等於光阻最佳焦點。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Focus and dose are the same control variable.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A height-sensor reading equals the resist best focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.summary: 曝光焦距與劑量控制涉及跨國材料、設備與量測合作。本課程地圖選用ASML Veldhoven 園區（High-NA 研究代表地）作為公開研究或設備技術的代表位置。課程練習以公開原理連結圖形、材料與驗證，不宣稱此處為唯一發明地、所有技術的生產工廠或實際機台位置。
courses.summaryEn: Exposure focus and dose control involves international collaboration in materials, equipment and metrology. The map uses ASML Veldhoven campus: High-NA reference location as a public research or equipment-technology reference. Exercises connect patterns, materials and validation through public principles; this is not claimed to be the sole invention site, a factory producing every technology, or an instrument location.
